release_notes.stringValue:
• Faster & More Responsive Live Scoring: Snappy ball-by-ball updates and instant scorecard refresh
• Redesigned Squad & Player Selector: Effortlessly pick players and manage team rosters
• Modern Material 3 UI: Polished dialogs, match history cards, and seamless dark mode
• Reliable Cloud Sync: Instant match backup and real-time score updates across league members
• Performance & Bug Fixes: Smoother app startup, lower memory usage, and improved overall stability
